uncited: **Initialize Storage:** Allocate an array of 64-bit unsigned integers large enough to hold $I_{max} + 1$ bits.
The size of the array is $\lceil (size_x \cdot size_y \cdot size_z) / 64 \rceil$.
- **Grid Size Limits:** The maximum index must fit within the addressable range of the integer type used for indexing.
- **Atomic Contention:** In highly parallel implementations, many threads writing to the same 64-bit word can cause lock contention.
Coordinates are packed into two `GL_SHORT` values.
Unpacking is performed in a vertex program.
